nodes.name: DashboardDropzone
nodes.description:
Full-page dropzone that handles drag-and-drop file uploads and URL paste events.

Intercepts global paste events (excluding inputs/textareas) to auto-submit URLs.
Shows a visual overlay during drag or active upload operations.

nodes.name: deleteUserAsAdmin
nodes.description:
Server action that deletes a user by ID, including all their items, rooms, files, and auth record.
Requires admin access with MFA at aal2. Logs activity audit trail and triggers admin notification.

nodes.name: AdminInvitesPage
nodes.description: Next.js page that lists all invites with filtering by status and origin, pagination, and stats.

nodes.name: AdminProtectedLayout
nodes.description:
Layout that gates access to admin-only pages. Redirects to login if unauthenticated, to dashboard
if not admin, to settings if MFA not set up, or to /admin/verify if not at aal2.

nodes.name: AddToRoomPopover
nodes.description:
Popover for adding or removing an item from manual rooms.

Lazily fetches the user's manual rooms on first open and toggles membership
for each room via API calls.

nodes.name: ColorHighlightOverlay
nodes.description:
Canvas overlay that darkens image pixels dissimilar to a hovered color.

Preloads and caches pixel data in LAB color space. When `hoveredColorHex`
changes, renders a new mask and crossfades between two canvas layers to
avoid flickering.

nodes.name: calculateWidths
nodes.description:
Calculate width percentages for colors with minimum width enforcement.
Small colors are bumped to the minimum, and larger colors are scaled down
proportionally so the total always equals 100%.

nodes.name: ColorsBar
nodes.description:
Interactive horizontal color bar showing dominant colors from an image.

Click to copy a hex value; Cmd/Ctrl+click to trigger a color search.
On touch devices, long-press and drag to explore colors.

nodes.name: LocationDisplay
nodes.description:
Displays location data (neighborhood, city, region, country) and a map.
Used by both editable (LocationDropzone) and read-only contexts.

nodes.name: LocationDropzone
nodes.description:
Drag-and-drop zone for setting an item's location from image EXIF data.

Accepts image files via drag-and-drop or file picker, extracts GPS
coordinates from EXIF, and shows a confirmation dialog before saving.
When a manual override exists alongside an original EXIF location, provides
a "Restore original" action.

nodes.name: LocationMap
nodes.description:
Displays a static Mapbox map image for the given coordinates.

Fetches the map via the server-side proxy at `/api/v1/map-image` to keep
the Mapbox token secret. The image links to Google Maps.

nodes.name: LocationOverrideDialog
nodes.description:
Confirmation dialog shown when updating an item's location from image EXIF data.

Displays current location alongside the new GPS coordinates extracted from a
dropped image file. On confirm, POSTs the new coordinates to the location API.

nodes.name: LocationPreview
nodes.description: Compact location summary showing geocoded place names, coordinates, and an optional map.

nodes.name: SaveAsRoomButton
nodes.description:
Button that opens a dialog to save the current search filters as a new dynamic room.

Only renders when there are active filters. On creation, navigates to the new room page.

nodes.name: ItemCard
nodes.description:
Grid card for a single item with click-to-expand detail dialog.

Handles image/article/twitter/video content types, progressive image loading,
swipe-to-dismiss on touch devices, editing (name, tags, notes, links, location,
privacy), room membership, and deletion.

nodes.name: ItemDetailDialogWrapper
nodes.description:
Wrapper component for the detail dialog with AnimatePresence.
Reduces duplication across different item card types.

nodes.name: ItemsGrid
nodes.description: Masonry grid of items with infinite scroll, empty states, and result count footer.

nodes.name: DashboardLayout
nodes.description:
Layout wrapping all dashboard pages.

Verifies authentication, redirects to complete-signup if username is missing,
and wraps children in the onboarding dialog and full-page dropzone.

nodes.name: DashboardPage
nodes.description:
Main dashboard page that server-renders the first page of the user's items.

Passes initial data to `SearchableItemsGrid` for hydration.

nodes.name: SearchableItemsGrid
nodes.description:
Items grid with integrated search, infinite scroll, and processing status polling.

Switches between paginated items and search results depending on whether a
search query or filters are active.

nodes.name: UploadWidget
nodes.description:
File upload widget for selecting and uploading an image from the file picker.

Validates file type and size, reads image dimensions, uploads to Supabase
Storage, then creates an item record via the API. Tracks upload analytics.

nodes.name: DevLayout
nodes.description:
Dev layout - only accessible in non-production environments.
All pages under /dev/* are blocked in production.

nodes.name: FilterTypesTable
nodes.description: Table showing all available filter types with their labels, descriptions, and AND/OR support.

nodes.name: HeadingIdProvider
nodes.description:
Provides context for generating stable, unique heading IDs within a document.

Tracks which base IDs have been used and appends numeric suffixes for duplicates,
ensuring each heading instance gets a consistent ID across re-renders.

nodes.name: useHeadingId
nodes.description: Returns the `getOrCreateId` function from the nearest `HeadingIdProvider`.

nodes.name: HeadingLink
nodes.description:
Heading element with a copy-link button and smooth-scroll highlight on hash navigation.

Clicking the heading copies the URL with the heading's fragment to the clipboard.
On page load, scrolls to and highlights the heading if its ID matches the URL hash.

nodes.name: HelpNav
nodes.description: Sidebar/top navigation for the help section with active-page highlighting.

nodes.name: getTextFromChildren
nodes.description:
Recursively extracts text content from React children.
Handles strings, numbers, arrays, and React elements with nested children.

nodes.name: FilteringHelpPage
nodes.description: Help page explaining the filtering system, rendered from a Markdown file.

nodes.name: AppLayout
nodes.description:
Root layout for authenticated app routes.

Verifies the user is authenticated and has completed signup (has a username).
Redirects to `/login` or `/complete-signup` as needed.

nodes.name: RoomsList
nodes.description:
Displays the user's rooms as a grid of cards with type badges and filter previews.

Shows an empty-state prompt when no rooms exist.

nodes.name: NewRoomForm
nodes.description:
Form for creating a new room with animated placeholder cycling, AI emoji suggestions,
and room type selection (static or dynamic with filters).

nodes.name: RoomsPage
nodes.description: Rooms listing page showing all of the authenticated user's rooms.

Requires at least one filter or query parameter.

Full video display for the detail dialog.
Uses facade pattern: shows thumbnail with play button initially,
loads iframe only when user clicks to play.

nodes.name: useGridDensity
nodes.description:
Manages grid density state with pinch-to-zoom support and keyboard shortcuts.

Wraps the density store and responds to the current viewport breakpoint to
provide the correct CSS values for frame width, gap, border radius, and
font scale.

nodes.name: useGridPinch
nodes.description:
Detects pinch-to-zoom gestures and keyboard zoom shortcuts on a container element.

Handles trackpad pinch (via ctrlKey + wheel), touch pinch, and Cmd/Ctrl +/-/0
shortcuts. Scale deltas are accumulated and only fire the callback once the
threshold is crossed. Returns a ref to attach to the target container.

nodes.name: useInfiniteScroll
nodes.description:
Triggers a callback when a sentinel element scrolls into view, for loading
more content.

Uses IntersectionObserver with a 200px root margin. Only fires on the rising
edge (not intersecting -> intersecting) to prevent duplicate loads.

nodes.name: useUpload
nodes.description:
Manages URL submission and image file uploads.

URL submissions are sent to the API for background processing.
File uploads go to Supabase Storage first, then create an item record via the API —
if the item creation fails the uploaded file is cleaned up automatically.

Both paths show toast notifications, track milestones, invalidate the items cache,
and redirect to the dashboard when the user isn't already there.

nodes.name: signOut
nodes.description:
Signs the current user out, tracks the logout event in PostHog,
then revalidates the layout cache and redirects to the login page.

nodes.name: getUserActivityOverview

nodes.name: getGlobalDailyActivity

1. "First Last" if both exist
2. "First" if only firstName exists
3. "@username" if username exists

Note: lastName alone is skipped - we fall back to username.

When any item transitions from "processing" to another status, invalidates the items query.

structuredParams.name: processingItemIds
structuredParams.description: Array of item IDs that are currently in "processing" status

nodes.name: useThemePreference
nodes.description:
Manages the user's theme preference (light/dark/auto).

On mount, restores the preference from localStorage (or falls back to the
DOM/cookie value) and applies it. The returned `toggle` cycles through
auto -> light -> dark and persists the choice.

nodes.name: getAuthenticatedUser
nodes.description:
Get the authenticated user with all profile data.
Uses React cache() to deduplicate calls within a single request.

Data priority: DB values take precedence over OAuth metadata.

Returns null if not authenticated.

nodes.name: parseEmailToUsername
nodes.description:
Parses an email into a base username candidate.
This is a pure function that doesn't check availability.

nodes.name: isUsernameAvailable
nodes.description: Checks if a username is available in the database.

nodes.name: generateUsernameFromEmail
nodes.description:
Generates an available username from an email address.
Returns the first available username (base, base1, base2, etc.)

nodes.name: findNextAvailableUsername
nodes.description:
Finds the next available username given a base.
Used when a user's preferred username is taken.

nodes.name: validateUsername
nodes.description:
Full username validation including format, reserved words, and offensive content.
Does NOT check database availability.

nodes.name: isReservedWord
nodes.description: Checks if a username is reserved (case-insensitive).

nodes.name: containsOffensiveContent
nodes.description: Checks if a username contains any offensive terms as substrings.

nodes.name: useUsernameAvailability
nodes.description:
Manages username input with debounced server-side availability checking.

Performs instant format validation, skips the API call for case-only
changes, and provides a suggestion when the chosen name is taken.

nodes.name: validateUsernameFormat
nodes.description: Validates username format (does not check availability or reserved words).

nodes.name: cn
nodes.description:
Merges class names using clsx and tailwind-merge, resolving Tailwind
conflicts so the last conflicting utility wins.

nodes.name: formatBytes
nodes.description: Format bytes as a human-readable string (e.g., "1.5 GB")

nodes.name: formatBytesParts
nodes.description: Format bytes and return value and unit separately for custom styling

nodes.name: getUserInitials
nodes.description:
Get initials from a user's first name, last name, or email.
Simpler version for admin panel where we have these as separate params.

nodes.name: getFileSizeFromMeta
nodes.description:
Safely extract file size from item metadata.
Returns 0 if size is not a valid non-negative number.

nodes.name: formatDuration
nodes.description: Format duration in seconds to MM:SS or HH:MM:SS format

nodes.name: fetchYouTubeOEmbed
nodes.description: Fetch YouTube video metadata via oEmbed API

nodes.name: fetchVimeoOEmbed
nodes.description: Fetch Vimeo video metadata via oEmbed API

nodes.name: getYouTubeThumbnailUrl
nodes.description:
Get YouTube thumbnail URL
YouTube has predictable thumbnail URLs based on video ID
Returns the highest quality thumbnail URL (maxresdefault)
Note: maxresdefault may not exist for all videos, caller should fallback to hqdefault

nodes.name: getVideoEmbedUrl
nodes.description:
Get privacy-respecting video embed URL
Uses youtube-nocookie.com for YouTube to prevent tracking
Includes autoplay=1 for use with facade pattern (thumbnail → iframe on click)

nodes.name: fetchYouTubeMetadata
nodes.description: Fetch video metadata for a YouTube video

nodes.name: fetchVimeoMetadata
nodes.description: Fetch video metadata for a Vimeo video

nodes.name: fetchVideoMetadata
nodes.description: Fetch video metadata for any supported platform

nodes.name: checkYouTubeThumbnailExists
nodes.description:
Check if a YouTube thumbnail URL exists (maxresdefault may not exist for all videos)
Returns true if the thumbnail exists, false otherwise

nodes.name: getBestYouTubeThumbnailUrl
nodes.description:
Get the best available YouTube thumbnail URL
Tries maxresdefault first, falls back to hqdefault

nodes.name: analyzeImageColorsOnly
nodes.description:
Extract only color information from an image using Google Cloud Vision API.
Uses only IMAGE_PROPERTIES feature ($1.50/1000 vs $6.75/1000 for all features).

nodes.name: joinWaitlist
nodes.description: Add an email to the waitlist

nodes.name: getWaitlistStats
nodes.description: Get waitlist statistics

nodes.name: middleware
nodes.description: Next.js middleware entry point — delegates to Supabase session management.

nodes.name: useCommandPaletteStore
nodes.description:
Manages command palette open/close state, the active page within the palette,
and the upload dialog visibility.

nodes.name: useGridDensityStore
nodes.description:
Manages the user's preferred grid density level, persisted to localStorage.

Shows a toast notification with the new zoom level whenever the density changes.

nodes.name: getDensityIndex
nodes.description: Returns the numeric index of a density level within `DENSITY_LEVELS`.

nodes.name: getDensityByIndex
nodes.description: Returns the density level at the given index, clamped to valid bounds.

nodes.name: useMilestoneStore
nodes.description:
Manages onboarding milestone progress -- which milestones have been completed,
which are still pending, and their display configuration.

nodes.name: useUserStore
nodes.description:
Manages the authenticated user's profile fields on the client.

Fields use a three-state model: `undefined` means not yet hydrated from the
server, `null` means explicitly empty, and a string/number is the actual value.
`hydrateUser` only fills in fields that are still `undefined`, so client-side
mutations made before hydration are preserved.

nodes.name: adminNotificationTask
nodes.description:
Sends an email notification to all admin users.

Delivers in parallel to all admins and reports partial success if some
emails fail.

nodes.name: analyzeImageTask
nodes.description:
Full image processing pipeline: downloads the image from Supabase Storage,
extracts EXIF/GPS data, runs color analysis and OpenAI Vision in parallel,
generates CLIP visual and text embeddings, and triggers smart room sync.

Marks the item as `failed` on error so the UI can show processing status.

nodes.name: checkGravatarTask
nodes.description:
Checks whether a Gravatar exists for the user's email and, if found, saves
it as their avatar. Skips if the user already has an avatar set.

nodes.name: downloadAndStoreImage
nodes.description:
Downloads an image from a URL and stores it in Supabase storage.
Returns the file key, content type, and size for the caller to handle.
nodes.returnType: Promise<{ fileKey: string; contentType: string; size: number } | null>

nodes.name: classifyUrlTask
nodes.description:
Classifies a URL into a content type (tweet, article, image, video) and
processes it accordingly.

Resolves short URLs, delegates to specialised handlers for Twitter/YouTube/
Vimeo/direct images, and falls back to article extraction via Readability.
Marks the item as `failed` on error.

nodes.name: handleTwitterArticle
nodes.description:
Handle a Twitter/X Article URL.
Twitter Articles cannot be fetched programmatically (returns 403/500),
so we store them with minimal metadata as an article type.

nodes.name: transformTweetData
nodes.description:
Transform raw tweet data from react-tweet/api into our TwitterDetails format.
Exported for testing purposes.

nodes.name: handleTwitterUrl
nodes.description: Handle a Twitter/X URL by fetching tweet data and storing it.

nodes.name: downloadAndStoreThumbnail
nodes.description:
Downloads an image from a URL and stores it in Supabase storage.
Returns the file key and size.
nodes.returnType: Promise<{ fileKey: string; size: number } | null>

nodes.name: handleVideoUrl
nodes.description: Handle a YouTube or Vimeo URL by fetching video metadata and storing it.

nodes.name: reconcileUserDataTask
nodes.description:
Daily reconciliation task for user data.

Reconciles:
1. Storage and item counts - ensures cached values match actual data
2. Email sync - ensures DB email matches Supabase auth email (source of truth)

nodes.name: reprocessImagesTask
nodes.description:
Re-triggers `analyze-image` for every image item in the database.

Batches items in chunks of 500 to stay within the Trigger.dev
`batchTrigger` limit.
